title: Classification of almost Maiorana--McFarland functions outside M sharp
summary: Characterize the admissible mapping and Boolean-function pairs that produce almost Maiorana--McFarland bent functions outside the completed class.

formal_statement.body: For each $m\ge 4$, characterize pairs $(\phi,h)$ with $\phi:\mathbb F_2^{m+1}\to\mathbb F_2^{m-1}$ satisfying Theorem III.1 such that $f(x,y)=x\cdot\phi(y)+h(y)$ is bent and belongs to $GMM_{m+1}\setminus\mathcal M^{\#}$. State the classification modulo the affine-equivalence convention used by the source.

scope.domain: Almost Maiorana--McFarland bent functions and membership outside the completed Maiorana--McFarland class
assumptions: Theorem III.1 applies to the pair (phi,h)
f is considered modulo the source equivalence convention
The target class is GMM_(m+1) outside M sharp
scope.unresolved_remainder: The 2026 rotation-symmetric result constructs restricted outside-M-sharp families, but an exact necessary-and-sufficient classification of all admissible (phi,h) pairs remains unresolved.

citations.label: Polujan--Kudin--Pasalic, Rotation-Symmetric Bent Functions Outside the Completed Maiorana-McFarland Class

progress.summary: The source asks for a characterization of mappings yielding almost Maiorana--McFarland bent functions outside M sharp.
A later TIT paper constructs infinite rotation-symmetric outside-M-sharp families, which are a strict restricted subfamily rather than a complete classification.
